for name in \
  "ToolRegistry inputSchema validation (acceptance) rejects invalid input before calling the executor and keeps valid input unmodified" \
  "ToolRegistry inputSchema validation (acceptance) throws synchronously when registering a static tool with an invalid inputSchema" \
  "ToolRegistry inputSchema validation (acceptance) validates per call against the schema resolved from a dynamic ToolDefinitionSource" \
  "ToolRegistry inputSchema validation (acceptance) logs a warning on invalid input and omits raw input values from logs and rejection text" \
  "ToolRegistry inputSchema validation (acceptance) feeds a schema validation rejection back to the model so a corrected follow-up call succeeds"
do
  echo "=== $name ==="
  node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts::$name" || true
done
